CASE
    WHEN (result_origin_kind = 'legacy_prepare_v1'::text) THEN NULL::uuid
    ELSE attempt_id
END

body.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((combined_actor_digest IS NULL) AND (combined_actor_revision IS NULL)) OR ((actor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (combined_actor_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (combined_actor_revision ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'::text))), false))
FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id, report_id) REFERENCES profiled_result_reports(attempt_id, report_id)

CHECK (COALESCE((((result_origin_kind = 'legacy_prepare_v1'::text) AND (origin_execution_receipt_digest IS NULL) AND (origin_stopped_ack_bytes_digest IS NULL)) OR ((result_origin_kind = ANY (ARRAY['phase_execution_v2'::text, 'phase_refresh_execution_v1'::text])) AND (origin_execution_receipt_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (origin_stopped_ack_bytes_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))), false))
FOREIGN KEY (result_origin_phase_attempt_id, origin_stopped_ack_bytes_digest) REFERENCES profiled_stopped_receipts(attempt_id, phase_ack_digest)
FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id, report_id) REFERENCES profiled_result_reports(attempt_id, report_id)
FOREIGN KEY (release_id) REFERENCES profiled_verified_releases(release_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CHECK (((lease_expires_at_ms IS NULL) OR ((lease_expires_at_ms > created_at_ms) AND (lease_expires_at_ms <= (created_at_ms + 75000)))))
CHECK (((state = 'confirmed'::text) = ((receipt IS NOT NULL) AND (outbox IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((state = 'confirmed'::text) OR ((receipt IS NULL) AND (outbox IS NULL) AND (NOT outbox_acknowledged))))
FOREIGN KEY (settlement_operation_id, attempt_id) REFERENCES profiled_settlement_evaluations(operation_id, attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

body.body:
BEGIN
 IF OLD.kind='profiled_v1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_authority_hot WHERE attempt_id=OLD.attempt_id)
    AND (NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state OR NEW.execution_deadline_ms IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.execution_deadline_ms)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'hot authority owns current profiled state' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF OLD.kind='profiled_v1' AND NOT OLD.holds_task AND NEW.holds_task
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_authority_hot WHERE attempt_id=OLD.attempt_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'released profiled claim cannot be reacquired' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF OLD.kind='profiled_v1' AND OLD.holds_task AND NOT NEW.holds_task
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_authority_hot WHERE attempt_id=OLD.attempt_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_verified_releases WHERE attempt_id=OLD.attempt_id)
    AND NOT profiled_never_granted_valid(OLD.attempt_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'actual owner-verified release record required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END

DECLARE current_hot JSONB;
BEGIN
 SELECT state INTO STRICT current_hot FROM profiled_authority_hot WHERE attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id;
 IF (current_hot->>'status' IN ('finished','declined')
     AND current_hot#>>'{stop,kind}' IN ('not_started','stopped')
     AND jsonb_typeof(current_hot->'owner')='object'
     AND (current_hot#>>'{retention,kind}'='retained' OR (current_hot#>>'{retention,kind}'='not_required' AND current_hot#>>'{stop,kind}'='not_started'))
     AND current_hot#>>'{effects,kind}'='quiescent'
     AND NEW.stop_evidence_digest=current_hot#>>'{stop,receipt,digest}'
     AND NEW.effect_receipt_digest=current_hot#>>'{effects,receipt,digest}'
     AND (current_hot#>>'{retention,kind}'='not_required' OR NEW.source_receipt_digest=current_hot#>>'{retention,receipt,digest}')) IS NOT TRUE
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release requires terminal owner/stop/source/effect completeness' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END

body.args: attempt uuid, owner_node uuid, origin_kind text, execution_digest text, stopped_ack_digest text
body.body:
SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM profiled_phase_execution_grants g
  JOIN profiled_v2_proposals p USING(attempt_id)
  JOIN profiled_started_receipts started USING(attempt_id)
  JOIN profiled_stopped_receipts stopped USING(attempt_id)
  WHERE g.attempt_id=attempt AND g.node_id=owner_node AND started.node_id=owner_node AND stopped.node_id=owner_node
   AND g.receipt_digest=execution_digest AND stopped.phase_ack_digest=stopped_ack_digest
   AND started.initial_authority_kind='phase_execution_v2' AND stopped.initial_authority_kind='phase_execution_v2'
   AND started.initial_authority_receipt_digest=g.receipt_digest AND stopped.initial_authority_receipt_digest=g.receipt_digest
   AND started.phase_terminal_qualification=stopped.phase_terminal_qualification
   AND convert_from(started.phase_envelope_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'=convert_from(stopped.phase_envelope_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'
   AND convert_from(started.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'=convert_from(started.phase_envelope_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'
   AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'=convert_from(stopped.phase_envelope_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'negotiation'
   AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB#>>'{origin,execution_receipt_digest}'=g.receipt_digest
   AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB#>>'{origin,accepted_receipt_digest}'=g.accepted_receipt_digest
   AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB->'original'=convert_from(stopped.receipt_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB
   AND ((origin_kind='phase_execution_v2' AND p.proposal#>'{negotiation,contract}'='{"digest":"ff60400da09f3de166b7931bc386c89218cb76a6c9e5276dff37c5fce28ca3e5","id":"aq.admission.preparation-v2-contract","version":"1"}'::JSONB AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB#>'{negotiation,contract}'='{"digest":"292c30eba95b8dd6f1d9a7bf75775bc5d0f9ecb54644047747f9593d538c0a4a","id":"aq.phase-terminal.contract","version":"1"}'::JSONB)
    OR (origin_kind='phase_refresh_execution_v1' AND p.proposal#>'{negotiation,contract}'='{"digest":"e41c08e3c8200f84b75824bff779833c9b8e5279ac63d2d91af12d9879deef56","id":"aq.admission.preparation-registry-refresh-v1-contract","version":"1"}'::JSONB AND convert_from(stopped.phase_ack_bytes,'UTF8')::JSONB#>'{negotiation,contract}'='{"digest":"f9af55c49127a8cb93f03ef5bbb28313d13f94a221affa3e26d91d45bffd6c2d","id":"aq.phase-terminal.registry-refresh-v1.contract","version":"1"}'::JSONB))
 )

BEGIN
 IF NEW.state#>>'{stop,kind}'='running' AND OLD.state#>>'{stop,kind}'<>'running'
 AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_owner_journals WHERE attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_attempts a JOIN execution_nodes n ON a.node_id=n.node_id WHERE a.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND n.state ? 'native'))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_started_receipts r JOIN profiled_owner_journals j USING(attempt_id)
   WHERE r.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND r.before_record_revision=OLD.record_revision AND j.phase='started')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native running projection requires original started receipt'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END

BEGIN
 IF NEW.state#>>'{stop,kind}'='stopped' AND OLD.state#>>'{stop,kind}'<>'stopped'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_started_receipts WHERE attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiled_stopped_receipts r JOIN profiled_owner_journals j USING(attempt_id)
  WHERE r.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND r.before_record_revision=OLD.record_revision AND j.phase='stopped'
  AND NEW.state->'stop'=jsonb_build_object('kind','stopped','receipt',jsonb_build_object('id','aq.native-stopped/'||NEW.attempt_id::TEXT,'version','1','digest',encode(sha256(r.receipt_bytes),'hex'))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native stopped projection requires original stopped receipt'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
